objective: Evaluate the already frozen ABCB1 v0.1 model once on the identity-clean strict regulatory/primary-study pool v4 without refit, calibration, threshold tuning, feature selection, applicability-domain modification, or post-result entity removal.

blindness_audit.boundary: The v4 entities have not appeared in prior prediction CSVs by exact InChIKey, connectivity block, or exact normalized name. This supports a pre-score blind evaluation of the frozen model, but it is not equivalent to a future multi-laboratory prospective study.

supporting_locks.role: historical gate definitions and comparators only; its scored entities are not pooled into the v4 primary metric

primary_analysis.prediction: frozen calibrated probability and fixed threshold 0.5

entity_bootstrap.sampling: stratified with replacement within directional label

cluster_bootstrap.sampling: resample all upstream_experiment_cluster units with replacement and retain all entities in each sampled cluster; discard one-class replicates
cluster_bootstrap.reason: multiple entities from the same paper or sponsor study are not treated as independent laboratories

uncertainty.paired_model_comparison: entity-stratified paired bootstrap using the same resampled indices

applicability_analysis.frozen_similarity_metric: Morgan radius 2, 2048 bits, no chirality, Tanimoto
applicability_analysis.outside_rule: maximum training similarity below frozen self-nearest q10

validated_binary_predictor_requires_all: entity-bootstrap lower 95% CI for balanced accuracy > 0.5
cluster-bootstrap lower 95% CI for balanced accuracy > 0.5
entity-bootstrap lower 95% CI for ROC AUC > 0.5
minimum leave-one-cluster-out balanced accuracy > 0.5 among estimable two-class subsets
no class has sensitivity or specificity below 0.5 at the fixed threshold
predeclared_claim_gates.failure_action: Do not tune on v4. Retain v0.1 only as a bounded screening/boundary-audit tool and use the frozen errors to design an assay-aware v0.2 training strategy; reserve any later temporal or experimental set for another untouched evaluation.

reporting_rules: Report all 33 predictions regardless of correctness or applicability band.
Report entity-bootstrap and cluster-bootstrap intervals side by side.
Report full confusion matrix and every error with source, similarity, and applicability band.
Report the four reused multi-entity clusters explicitly and do not describe 33 entities as 33 independent studies.
Do not combine this ordinary-drug benchmark with ADC release-species rows as if they shared one endpoint.
Do not call the model an ADC-specific predictor unless a separate ADC release-species validation gate later passes.
